user.title: Canal de Isabel II
user.description: The details you log in to the [virtual office]({portal_url}) with. The login is done by the session helper, which has to be installed: without it nothing is downloaded.

data_description.document: The NIF or NIE you log in with.
data_description.profile: The profile you choose on the virtual office's login form.

reauth_confirm.title: Virtual office credentials
reauth_confirm.description: The session helper needs your document number and your password for the virtual office to log in. If it already had them, the portal did not accept them: check them and enter them again.{reason}

abort.reauth_successful: Credentials saved. The session helper will log in within a minute.

helper_missing.title: The Canal de Isabel II session helper is not answering
helper_missing.description:
The integration needs to log in to the virtual office to download the consumption, and the session helper is what does it. No helper has asked for work in the last few minutes.

Check that the helper is installed and running and, if it is a Docker container, that its `HA_URL` and token are right. This notice goes away when the helper connects again.

login_challenge.title: Canal de Isabel II asks for a check before logging in
login_challenge.description:
The portal showed a check (captcha) that a person has to answer. Open the session helper's browser and log in by hand.

The helper will try again by itself at {retry_at}. This notice goes away once there is a session.

login_challenge_link.title: Canal de Isabel II asks for a check before logging in
login_challenge_link.description:
The portal showed a check (captcha) that a person has to answer. [Open the session helper's browser]({url}) and log in by hand.

The helper will try again by itself at {retry_at}. This notice goes away once there is a session.

login_failed.title: Could not log in to Canal de Isabel II
login_failed.description:
The session helper could not log in to the virtual office: the portal did not answer as expected. The portal may be down for a while, or its page may have changed.

The helper will try again at {retry_at}. If it keeps happening, open its browser to see what the portal shows and log in by hand.

login_failed_link.title: Could not log in to Canal de Isabel II
login_failed_link.description:
The session helper could not log in to the virtual office: the portal did not answer as expected. The portal may be down for a while, or its page may have changed.

The helper will try again at {retry_at}. If it keeps happening, [open its browser]({url}) to see what the portal shows and log in by hand.

session_request.name: Ask for work
session_request.description: For the session helper: returns the entries that need a portal session, with their credentials.

set_session.name: Deliver session
set_session.description: For the session helper: delivers a portal session. The integration downloads the data straight away.

jsessionid.name: JSESSIONID cookie
jsessionid.description: Value of the JSESSIONID cookie of a logged-in portal session.

entry_id.name: Entry
entry_id.description: Which Canal de Isabel II entry it is for. Only needed when there is more than one.

report_login.name: Report a failed login
report_login.description: For the session helper: says that it could not log in, so the integration can tell the person.

result.name: Result
result.description: refused: the portal rejected the credentials. challenge: the captcha asks for a person. failed: the portal did not answer as expected.

entry_id.name: Entry
entry_id.description: Which Canal de Isabel II entry it is for. Only needed when there is more than one.

retry_at.name: Next try
retry_at.description: When the helper will try again (ISO date and time).

no_entry.message: There is no Canal de Isabel II entry.

several_entries.message: Canal de Isabel II is set up more than once: say which entry with entry_id.

not_loaded.message: The Canal de Isabel II entry is not loaded.

session_rejected.message: The portal did not accept this session.

portal_unreachable.message: Could not check the session with the portal: {detail}
